requirement_vague: Verify empty feed is returned when user follows nobody

omissions.description: GET /api/articles/feed endpoint for returning a personalized feed is missing, so a user who follows nobody cannot receive an empty feed response with articlesCount 0 and articles [].
omissions.reasoning: The code defines /api/articles and /api/articles/{slug} routes, but there is no route handler for GET /api/articles/feed at all. Because the endpoint does not exist, the required empty-follows behavior cannot be exercised or returned.
